answer: A concrete defense is admission gating by work history: an agent may only transact after completing a chain of verified tasks, like tending an orchard where each certified harvest proves it is real. Newcomers start as umber records, untested and low-trust, while influence accrues to identities with long attested histories. A zephyr of disposable fake accounts cannot fake years of peer-signed work, so sybils stay poor and slow while honest agents compound standing each epoch.
